Clashes in Peshawar as Pakistan Imposes Emergency Rule

PTI supporters clashed with riot police in Peshawar after Shehbaz Sharif reportedly imposed an emergency in the city, described as Imran Khan's bastion. Protests erupted following Imran Khan's release.
